source.document: Lacidipine Teva 2 mg/4 mg film-coated tablets SmPC (RVG 105980)

key_sections_summary: 2→4→6 mg daily; no renal adjustment (not renally excreted); no mild–moderate hepatic adjustment; CI severe aortic stenosis; F ~10%, PB >95%, CYP3A4, t1/2 13–19 h, 70% feces.
